title: statschema temporal ordering constraints weren't applied

found.by: lfc-source-statschema schemas/tpch.yaml, shape.py at SF 0.1 on Postgres 14

symptom: 296,006 of 600,000 lineitem rows (49.3%) had l_receiptdate before l_shipdate (TPC-H SF 0.1, Postgres 14)
cause: shape.py drew each column on its own and never read temporal_ordering_constraints; the schema said a post-generation fix-up step enforced them, and none ran
effect: A TPC-H copy from statschema's schema broke the spec's date order, so lead-time and late-shipment queries returned nonsense
fix: An offset rule (distribution: offset, from: <column>, min, max) makes a column the other's formula plus the offset; temporal_ordering_constraints are checked, and a pair without an offset gets GREATEST, logged. tpch.yaml: l_receiptdate = l_shipdate + 1 .. 30 days. Filled at SF 0.1 on Postgres: 600,000 rows, 0 out of order, each gap of 1 .. 30 days 20,000 times
